title: Agglutinant
summary: AGGLU'TINANT, noun Any viscous substance which unites other substances, by causing an adhesion; any application which tends to unite parts which have too little adhesion. AGGLU'TINANT, adjective Uniti

inlines.v: AGGLU'TINANT, noun Any viscous substance which unites other substances, by causing an adhesion; any application which tends to unite parts which have too little adhesion. AGGLU'TINANT, adjective Uniting as glue; tending to cause adhesion.
